name: GaitGuard
tagline: A sensor wearable that predicts falls from posture deviation and motion patterns.
problem: Falls in people living alone can go unnoticed.
solution: An ESP32 tracks posture against a calibrated baseline over a rolling window and a logistic model estimates fall probability, with a dashboard.
demo_moment: Team-described: simulate a stumble and see the risk rise.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Most Philanthropic Hack - Bloomberg” among 223 submissions.
Uses a personal baseline instead of fixed thresholds.
